evaluators.suitabilityLead: The 5 canonical criteria (handbook 3.2) — a good GenAI candidate meets these.

criteria.c3: Errors are tolerable or the output is cheap to verify
criteria.c4: The input data is available and legally usable
criteria.c5: Regulatory risk is low initially (back-office first, customer-facing later)

evaluators.readinessLead: 4 dimensions, 3 grades — the weakest dimension dominates (weakest-link rule).

questions.prohibited: Does it involve a prohibited practice (social scoring, manipulative techniques, emotion recognition at work/in education)?

evaluators.warnNotice: Prohibited or high-risk suggestion — a note is required. There is no automatic exclusion: the decision is yours.

manage_closely.title: Manage closely — resolve concerns early.
manage_closely.body: High influence and high exposure: their support is essential to the decision. Engage early, share plans, and address concerns before they escalate.

keep_satisfied.title: Keep satisfied — don't overload with detail.
keep_satisfied.body: High influence, lower exposure: you need their sign-off but not their attention to daily detail. Keep it concise and decision-focused; get explicit approval at key points.

keep_informed.title: Keep informed — the day-to-day impact lands here.
keep_informed.body: Lower influence, high exposure: the change affects them directly. Update regularly and gather feedback; their buy-in helps adoption.

monitor.title: Monitor — low priority for now.
monitor.body: Low influence and low exposure: minimal, periodic updates are enough. Watch for their role changing as the project progresses.

p2.e1Prerecorded: Success defined up front — not after the fact, by feel

goldenset.typeHint: This drives how the result recorder looks for this case.
goldenset.expectedNote: An open case has no single right answer — the criterion decides, we do not fabricate an expected value.
goldenset.humanControlNote: The answer type and the criteria are under human control — the AI only suggested.
goldenset.recorderSub: enter the solution's actual output — the field adapts to the answer type
goldenset.noRun: the system does not run — you enter it
goldenset.actualLabel: Actual output — the solution's generated answer
goldenset.judgeLine: The consultant decides · the final verdict is human
goldenset.overrideHint: You can override the AI anytime — classification is not automatic, your verdict is final.
goldenset.noAiYet: No AI suggestion for this case yet.
goldenset.residualNote: lands in the report as an ai_filled field — you confirm it in the editor.
goldenset.noticeRiskKept: The residual risk field is manual/confirmed — the suggestion did not overwrite it.
goldenset.belowWarn: Below threshold ({pct}% < {t}%). The report cannot be approved until the rate improves or the consultant overrides with a documented reason.
goldenset.noReportYet: No report yet — sync it from the measurement.
goldenset.thresholdText: The minimum pass rate required for the pilot. The AI never sets it — the consultant judges it by the use case's risk.

goldenset.fieldNoFailures: No failed or partial cases — every recorded golden set case passed.
goldenset.errNoUseCase: No selected use case — a shortlisted use case in P2 is needed first.
goldenset.errAlreadyHasCases: Test cases already exist — the AI suggestion only runs on an empty golden set.
goldenset.noticeNoBasis: The AI found no sufficient basis for test case suggestions — add the first one manually.
goldenset.errNeedsOptions: A choice type needs at least 2 options.
goldenset.errActualRequired: Provide the actual output in the type's form.
goldenset.errThresholdRange: The threshold is an integer between 1 and 100.
goldenset.errNoSet: No golden set for this project yet.
goldenset.errNoCasesToReport: No test cases — the report has nothing to summarise.
goldenset.errReportApproved: The report is Approved — start a new version from the editor.
goldenset.errSyncFirst: Sync the report from the measurement first.
goldenset.noticeNoRisk: The AI gave no risk suggestion.

builddoc.title: Solution documentation
builddoc.emptyText: The solution is built — now break it into components and link it back to the P0–P2 plan. Start by pulling in the components selected in P2, or upload the build material and let AI draft a structure from it.
builddoc.emptyNoSources: Upload build material on the Sources page first.
builddoc.emptyNote: AI suggests components, links, prompt items and control points from P2 and the uploaded material — you edit and confirm. Linking is always a human decision.
builddoc.coverageNoElements: No plan elements of this type — coverage is empty here.
builddoc.noCoverNote: no build component implements this plan element yet. Passive signal — no score.
builddoc.promptPick: Pick a prompt item from the list.
builddoc.promptHitlNote: Prompt extracted from the build material — the consultant edits/confirms it.
builddoc.originSeedNote: One P2 component can yield multiple build components (1-N). This one is already extracted — no need to re-enter it.
builddoc.originManualLong: Manual component — no P2 antecedent. The origin link stays empty (c-pattern).
builddoc.promptItemsEmpty: No prompt items for this component.
builddoc.implNote: Four target types. AI suggests only where there is textual basis (not forced); linking is the consultant's decision. Every chip is clickable — traversable from the other direction too.
builddoc.suggestedNote: AI suggested {n} links (dashed, ✦ mark). Accept (✓) or reject (×) — linking is a human decision, the system never decides for you.
builddoc.seedNote: AI loads from the P2 selected solution components. One P2 component can yield multiple build components (1-N). Pick what to pull in.
builddoc.seedEmpty: No P2 components — add them in the Solution plan module, or add manually.
builddoc.seedNotExtracted: not yet extracted · can be pulled
builddoc.seedPickedLine: {n} components selected — layer type and origin link are inherited.
builddoc.seedPickHint: Select the components to pull in.
builddoc.manualAiNote: After saving, AI suggests implementation links from the description — you confirm them.
builddoc.errNoSources: No build material uploaded — add a source first.
builddoc.errTargetUnknown: Target plan element not found — links cannot be fabricated.
builddoc.errPromptComponentRequired: A prompt item is bound to a component — pick one.
builddoc.errNoComponentsToSync: No confirmed components — confirm or add them first.
builddoc.errDocApproved: The Solution documentation is Approved — sync does not overwrite it. Continue in a new version.
builddoc.noticeLinksSuggested: ✦ {n} link suggestions created — confirm them on the detail view.
builddoc.noticeNoLinkBasis: AI found no linkable basis — links can be added manually.
builddoc.noticeAiFailed: Component saved, but link suggestion failed: {message}
builddoc.noticeNothingNew: AI found nothing new beyond the existing items.
